description: The EIP-712 typed data the account's owner signs (eth_signTypedData_v4, from the wallet owner() returns) to register an X25519 delivery key: domain Mercatura delivery, version 1, chain 4663, verifyingContract the account; DeliveryKey(address account, bytes32 pub, uint64 issuedAt). Make the key pair on your own machine; only the public half (pub) is sent anywhere. pub of all zeros revokes. Each registration needs a newer issuedAt than the last.

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

issuedAt.description: Optional unix seconds; now when left out. Sign and register the same value.

pub.description: The 32-byte X25519 public key, hex (all zeros revokes).

name: delivery_key_typed_data
title: House factor reviews: the typed data to sign
